title: Book 9 — Calliope, Chapter 77
paragraphs: After the woman's arrival, the Mantineians arrived, when all was over. Learning they had come too late for the battle, they were greatly grieved and said they deserved to be punished. Being informed that the Medes with Artabazos were in flight, they pursued them as far as Thessaly, though the Lacedaemonians tried to prevent them from pursuing fugitives. On their return home, they sent the leaders of their army into exile. After the Mantineians came the Eleians; they too, like the Mantineians, were greatly grieved and departed home; and these also, on their return, sent their leaders into exile. So much for the Mantineians and Eleians.
